fusions.name: Both Hind Legs
fusions.desc: Kicks out with both hind legs for 14 damage, knocking the target back 3.5 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flushed From Cover
fusions.desc: You kick off the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and move 15% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Reflex
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Bolt Instinct
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
